source.note: Metals and laminates checked by plain mechanics. SI: GPa, kg/m3, MPa. verified: the strength values were read in the source named; anything taken from elsewhere is said in the note.

rows.name: 6061-T6 aluminium
rows.source: Aluminum Design Manual minimums for 6061-T6 extrusions (Fty 35 ksi, Ftu 38 ksi; E 10,100 ksi, G 3,800 ksi, 0.098 lb/in3), as given in Kissell, Designing Aluminum Structures, slides 52-53 and 59
rows.note: Read in a secondary source; the Manual's own Table A.4.3 is not public.

rows.name: AlMgSi0.5 F25 (6060-T66) extrusion
rows.source: item Technical Data for profiles: Al Mg Si 0.5 F 25, Rp0.2 min. 195, Rm min. 245 N/mm2, E approx. 70,000, G approx. 25,000 N/mm2, 2.7 kg/dm3
rows.note: The same strengths and E are in Bosch Rexroth's technical data for its strut profiles (6063-T66).

rows.name: 4130 chromoly steel, normalized
rows.source: Wikipedia, 41xx steel: 4130 cold drawn, normalized, yield 480-590 MPa, tensile 590-760 MPa (lower ends used); E 205 GPa and 7.85 g/cm3 from Wicks Aircraft's 4130 sheet
rows.note: Strengths read through a page fetch, not by eye; MIL-T-6736 Condition N minimums were not readable. G from AZoM (fetch).

rows.name: Columbus Cromor (25CrMo4) tube
rows.source: Columbus 2020 Steel Catalogue: Cromor, UTS = 750 MPa, Ys = 700 MPa (homogeneous section)
rows.note: The catalogue gives no stiffness or density: E 205 GPa and 7.85 g/cm3 are from Wicks Aircraft's 4130 sheet (read), G 80 GPa from AZoM (fetch).

rows.name: Columbus Omnicrom (SL, Spirit, Life) tube
rows.source: Columbus 2020 Steel Catalogue: Omnicrom, UTS = 1300 MPa, Ys >= 920 MPa (homogeneous section)
rows.note: The catalogue gives no stiffness or density: E 205 GPa and 7.85 g/cm3 are from Wicks Aircraft's 4130 sheet (read), G 80 GPa from AZoM (fetch).

rows.name: Carbon/epoxy fabric laminate, 0/90
rows.source: Performance Composites Ltd, Mechanical Properties of Carbon Fibre Composite Materials (standard carbon fabric, 0/90, Vf 50 %, 120 C cure epoxy): E 70 GPa, in-plane shear modulus 5 GPa, tension 600 MPa, compression 570 MPa, 1.60 g/cc
rows.note: Generic guide values, read through a page fetch. The limit stress is the compressive strength (the lower). A real frame's layup adds +/-45 plies, which raise the shear modulus a great deal: describe your own laminate with customMaterial(...).

rows.name: Carbon/epoxy unidirectional, Toray T700S
rows.source: Toray T700S data sheet (rev. 11/24/2025), composite properties at 60 % fibre volume: 0 deg tensile modulus 134 GPa, tensile strength 2,860 MPa, compressive strength 1,450 MPa
rows.note: Along the fibres only: across them the sheet gives 81 MPa. Toray gives no shear modulus or laminate density: 5 GPa and 1.60 g/cc are Performance Composites' generic values (fetch). The limit stress is the compressive strength.
